theorems.name: Submission.lpf_rsn_local_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ W) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ‖ξ x‖ = 1) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M ∩ W) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
